description: A running task's script raises an ask of a person (on the host's own socket, with its run's token), or a chat's model does with its own tools (session, on its host's own socket): kept, and in the Inbox of every head that may manage its Bot (or chat) till it's answered, withdrawn or its run ends (its chat's archived or deleted). Answered as a button's pressed: inbox_wait, and for a chat, a message from the Inbox as its next turn.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

session.description: A chat's own ask: the asking chat's session id, from its own tools (their connection's hello as), in place of run and token.

run.description: The asking run's id (BAUDE_TASK_RUN): a task's script's.

title.description: What it's called in the Inbox's list (its body's first line, if none).

body.description: What it says: Markdown, as a message is written. ![alt](name) on a line of its own, or alone in a table's cell, shows one of its pictures there (by its name).

pictures.description: Its pictures, each by the name its body and buttons use.

buttons.description: What may be pressed: each tells the task, with the form's values.

form.description: Fields to fill (as a task's form has them): their values go with the button pressed.
